label: FDUSD launch by First Digital Labs
note: 2023-06-01: FDUSD launched by FD121 Limited (BVI); FDT custodian

label: Binance lists FDUSD with zero-fee promo (BUSD replacement)
note: 2023-07-26: Binance lists FDUSD with zero-fee promo as BUSD winds down

label: Sun insolvency claim vs. FDT, FDUSD depeg low ~$0.87
note: 2025-04-02: Justin Sun alleges FDT insolvency; FDUSD depegs to ~$0.87

label: First Digital Trust files Hong Kong defamation writ against Justin Sun
note: 2025-04-03: First Digital filed a writ of summons in the Hong Kong High Court (HCA 680/2025), initiating a defamation action against Justin Sun over his public insolvency allegations.

label: HK Stablecoins Ordinance in force: FDUSD enters licensing regime
note: 2025-08-01: Hong Kong Stablecoins Ordinance in force; FDUSD enters licensing regime

label: First Digital freezes 3.45M Ethereum FDUSD after Binance hack
note: At Ethereum block 26302072 (2026-10-30 00:46:11 UTC), the First Digital multisig froze six Ethereum addresses linked to the October 29 Binance hack, including attacker wallet 0x5227f603C1eE34CE3C06eFe6477003BDfCCB2f8c holding 3,454,894.92 FDUSD.
